query: WITH entities AS (SELECT id FROM agents WHERE COALESCE(project_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND (NOT $2 OR workflow_run_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3) AND (COALESCE(id > $5, true)) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $4) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $6 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at FROM entities i JOIN agent_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
